_meta.tweak_via: edit this file + commit; the retention job reads it on the next tick (no service reload needed)
_meta.rationale: Retention for the append-only larry-alerts.jsonl queue, which grows unbounded (1226 lines / ~770KB on 2026-06-03, no prior retention). The job keeps entries newer than retention_days OR the last min_retained_lines, WHICHEVER RETAINS MORE, then cursor-safely archives + drops the rest. retention_cut never exceeds the beacon/medic line-consumer offsets, so no pending alert is ever archived. Defaults are conservative; intended to become Pulse-Check self-optimizing per the Check III/VIII pattern (analyzer proposes a window, Larry approves, Forge writes this file) rather than hand-pinned long-term.
